text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan continued to rack up 
victories. The girl who once 
dishearteningly believed she wasn't worthy 
of the Mejiro name was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Focusing solely on victory, running 
with reckless abandon. Watching Ines 
Fujin's race seemed to show her the path 
she ought to take.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just Mejiro Ryan. Ines Fujin's 
running fired up everyone watching, 
filling countless people with energy and 
vigor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cheering voices will surely grow even 
louder at the upcoming Satsuki Sho. 
Everyone was looking forward to seeing her 
do her best... and seeing her seize 
victory.
